title: Spatio-Temporal Microclimate Prediction using Deep Learning
summary: A microclimate research model aims to inform urban design, heat-risk management, and irrigation through more detailed local forecasts.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The research describes deep-learning prediction of local climate conditions. Additional locations, seasons, model development, and external validation are planned. Its proposed benefits include better planning and thermal comfort, without a documented change in an implemented service or intervention.
purpose: Provide detailed microclimate information for planning and resource management.
system: Spatio-Temporal Microclimate Prediction using Deep Learning

ratings.reason: The microclimate work reports a research model, with authority/agritech validation still planned.
Thermal comfort and reduced heat-related health risks are intended uses of the forecasts, with no outcome measurement.
Urban heat mitigation and resource savings remain proposed downstream uses.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
